answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 32377 Country: India Title: The standing urinor (that is mounted on the wall) in which our clothes does not gets dirty by it. Question: The standing urinor (that is mounted on the wall) in which our clothes does not gets dirty by it.Is it right to toilet in it. Answer ID: 32377 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1119/646/D=1432) It is makrooh to urinate while standing. However, if one has any excuse or there is no clean place available to sit i.e. one fears to get touched with impurity then it is allowable to stand. But one should not develop this habit unnecessarily. It is mentioned in hadith that the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) said to Hadhrat Umar (رضى الله عنه): يا عمر لا تبل قائماً . O Umar, do not urinate while standing. (Mishkah, p. 43) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
